From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Finexa discovery recap and security evidence ask

Marissa — confirming retention & deletion language: 

- Cached request tokens: retained up to 30 days by default, configurable to 0 for customers who opt out.
- Aggregated telemetry/metrics: retained 90 days; rolled up metrics retained 365 days for trending.
- Full audit logs (access, configuration changes, request metadata): retained 365 days and available for export on request. Export SLA: 48-72 hours depending on volume.
- Deletion: we support data deletion requests; for private deployments we run the deletion within 7 business days and provide confirmation.

I’ll add a short paragraph about role-based access controls and KMS integration for encryption-at-rest.

-Dylan
